description: Remove a post from INSSIST Post Assistant, with its media. Only touches the INSSIST queue: a published entry is cleared from the list, the Instagram post itself is never affected. (Requires INSSIST PRO.)

draftId.description: Post id from draft_create or draft_list.

instance.description: Optional. Browser instance id from account_info; defaults to the active one.

name: draft_delete
title: Draft delete
